notes.title: Night Racer 1.1.0 Cross Platform Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Our team is excited to announce the launch of our massive cross platform update. The game will be playable across multiple platforms and devices. The first major device the game will be dropping on is iOS and Android coming August 31st. The Oculus Quest Version will be dropping a 2 weeks post that. Our team has been working incredibly hard to get the game to the same level across all the different platforms.

For all our supporters here's a first look of our cross platform multiplayer in action.

[previewyoutube=aplb05J82zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring the final car of the Ultimate Car Pack. It's called the ghostbuster. Along with that we've added the ability for the player to rebind keys in your controller and many more changes to the game.

Apart from this our team has been hard at work on the other versions of our game Night Racer. Check out the cross platform multiplayer showcase below.
[previewyoutube=Sq6Iqh2-7Ss;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to share more updates with all of you.

notes.title: Massive Backend Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
This is a truly very important update for us. Right from the start of development of the game we've always wanted to have as many people as possible play the game. The main objective with this update is reducing the barrier of entry for our game. Whether you're playing the game on a 3090 or a integrated graphics card we wanted to make sure the game runs great across all devices. Apart from that the new car in the Ultimate Car pack has been added welcome The Hatch to our roster. 

Here are a full list of changes made.
- Upgraded the project to a newer version of our game engine so we can keep pushing newer changes in the future.
- Optimized the graphics to run the game on basic graphic cards
- Added the Hatch to the car Roster.

We've got more exciting changes coming up which we can't wait to share with you. (New tracks and new cars ;))

notes.title: Night Racer Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Our team is excited to bring a brand new surprise to you. The brand new vehicle vehicle that storms and rams it's way into Night Racer is the Big Bad Bulldozer. Try it out by purchasing our Ultimate Car Pack DLC now.

Patch Notes
- Added the Big Bull to the game
- Fixed a few UI related issues
- Fixed the controller UI navigation issue
- Fixed an issue with the players playing on the Switch Pro controller

We've got big surprises coming soon. So keep an eye on the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes for a Massive Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you a brand new multiplayer update. You don't have to turn back if there are not many rooms for you to join. We're adding super challenging AI Bots which will test your abilities to the absolute limit. Don't worry though the second another player creates a room the AI Rooms will vanish.

Full Patch Notes
- Added Bot Rooms when no players are playing multiplayer.
- When a player creates a room the bot rooms disappear, you can join other players.
- Added the ability to move from the championship result screen to the next championship.
- Fixed colliders in a few levels.

More fixes coming soon. This Friday, there will be a new car dropping for all the owners of the Ultimate Car Pack.

notes.title: Patch Notes for a Massive Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Our team is excited to announce the 2nd car from the Ultimate Car Pack "The Vintage Vindcator". Take the car out for a spin and smash all the records out there. Along with that we've made a few community requested features. Check the patch notes below.

Update 1.0.5
- Added The Vintage Vindicator to the game, access it using the Ultimate Car Pack.
- Made the particles to be consistent for all the boosts.
- Close down the Pause button by pressing Escape.
- Removed Pause button from the gameplay to make sure the screen is not cluttered.
- The mouse cursor will automatically be removed when the game begins.

The game is being developed constantly, join our discord if you want to provide any feedback you would like to see with the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Today's update was mainly focused to improve the usuability of the game. One of the members of our discord group felt that they were spending a lot of time customising the car. We've now made it so that the car's customisation gets saved all the time. The update should work without any problems.
Apart from the task above we've also fixed a few bugs and optimized the game further.

The game is actively being improved, join our discord community if you have any feedback that would help us improve the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
In today's update, we have added a room filtering feature. Unfortunately the multiplayer does not have many players playing it right now, so we've added a button in the Join a room screen, which will allow you to cycle through all the regions to check if there is a lobby available for you to join quickly.

Apart from that a few minor fixes have been made improve the game.

If you want to find players to play multiplayer with join our Discord.

notes.title: Night Racer 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes: Today's patch adds new music to all the tracks and we've also added the much requested first person view. Immerse yourself into the world of Night Racer from a new perspective. Press the C button on the keyboard and Select/Back button on the Controller to activate it.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Day 1 Patch dropping tonight will have the following fixes.
- Added more screen resolutions so players can scale the game to fit the exact resolution their pc can run at.
- Added volume sliders to help control each musical element individually.
- Fixed a cloud save error in the tutorial, that occurs when you play the game first, uninstall it and then reinstall it again.
- Added keyboard and controller support for the volume sliders.
- Added visual and audio feedback when you finish a lap in multiplayer.
- Fixed the hit areas in few of the levels.

notes.title: Night Racer - Multiplayer Update and Discord Giveaway
notes.notes:
Welcome to the world of Night Racer - Multiplayer. Our team is really excited to show you how the multiplayer in our game will be working. We use a very simple flow to play multiplayer. Each game has a total of 4 cars. You can invite your friends to play by quickly sharing the region and room code. 

If you want to play with random players there will a long list of rooms where you can join. Since the game will be cross platform you can even play with your friends on the night racer mobile version on iOS or Android. 

The iOS and Android version of the game will be launching a week or 2 after the pc release of the game. 

You need a total of 300 coins to join a multiplayer lobby. Once the game begins you'll be able to play the game, emote while you make your way to the top of the race and win the entire pot of coins. Make sure to upgrade your cars by playing the arcade and championship modes before stepping in to the world of multiplayer.

We've added how the multiplayer mode will playout below for your enjoyment.

[previewyoutube=DOPDnKjRc9U;full][/previewyoutube]
